interview:
Honest report: **I did not win.** The session ended mid-game, with the round still in progress.

What happened:
- I started the game by entering the name "Player" and pressing Play.
- I inspected the game's logic and learned two important things: the guard dog moves **two** steps toward Le Chonk after each of my moves, and there's a hidden **slide mechanic** — tapping the cat's own square within 700ms of a move slides it one extra square in the same direction *without* the dog moving. That effectively lets the cat move 2 squares per dog-turn.
- Using that, I navigated the cat from the bottom-left (1,7) rightward and down to row 7, using the crates to pin the dog. I made a couple of misclicks along the way (the game showed "Le Chonk can only move one square" when I tapped the wrong cell), which cost moves but didn't end the round.
- At the point the session ended, the state was: **Moves: 6**, Le Chonk (orange) at column 4, row 7, the dog at column 3, row 6, and the fish still untouched at the top-right (7,1).

My plan was to keep dashing right along row 7 to column 7, then dash straight up the clear column 7 to grab the fish — the dog was trailing behind and blocked by crates, so the route looked safe. But the session ended before I could finish those last moves, so the game was left unfinished rather than won.
